ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   C. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wudhu.
   B. Say Wudhu has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Wudhu to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wudhu with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   C. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   B. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Etiquette of Eating and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on brushing teeth and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Fitness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Attributes of Allah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
